enable_free_init: enable the FreeInit noise re-initialization mechanism on a diffusers pipeline with butterworth filtering
disable_free_init: disable the FreeInit mechanism on a diffusers pipeline that has it enabled
check_free_init_enabled: check if the FreeInit mechanism is currently enabled on a diffusers pipeline
build_frequency_filter: build a butterworth, gaussian, or ideal frequency-domain low pass filter mask for FreeInit noise filtering
apply_frequency_filter: apply FFT-based frequency mixing to combine low-frequency signal with high-frequency noise for noise reinitialization
